description: This is an HTML source file that implements a web-based database viewer interface, including styles, structure, and client-side scripting for interacting with backend APIs to display database information and data tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets selected database and table, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data records for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a data table with data rows and handles wide content display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, handling null, objects, or long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses table cell content to show full or truncated data.
